text:
Hi Encomendas,
 



I hope this message finds you well. Further to our previous discussion on power supplies, I wanted to introduce the extensive line of Magnetic Components. These components are critical for ensuring efficiency and compliance in modern electronics.
The High Current Power Inductors are a prime example of the innovation available:
Engineered with flat wire and powder molding for high performance.
Achieve high saturation currents up to 150Amps with low core losses.
Magnetically shielded designs to minimize acoustic noise and interference, with AEC-Q200 qualified options.
These components are designed to provide a competitive advantage in both performance and cost. Would a sample of our High Current Power Inductors be helpful for your team's evaluation?
